name: Lifedrinker raises Vampiric Fang's damage by 25% (#1309)
contract: Lifedrinker 802576 carries ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108), MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), BasePoints 24 (real +25%, EffectDieSides=1), classmask (0,524288,0) which matches exactly the 8 direct-damage Vampiric Fang ranks (504093-504097, 553271-553272, 804726), no remainder outside that set. Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone (Unit.cpp) consumes SPELLMOD_DAMAGE generically via Unit::ApplySpellMod. spell_modifier queries this without casting or owning the target spell. 553272 (level 60) is the rank a level-80 character owns.
